entities.name: Aryl methyl ketone reduction
observations: The encoded transformation is Ar–C(=O)–CH3 → Ar–CH(OH)–CH3, while ethoxy, chloro, bromo, nitrile, and aromatic groups remain unchanged.

entities.name: Sodium borohydride
observations: ORD record ord-24609a5223c34cd78a78f558af13fca8 reports sodium borohydride in methanol for this ketone-to-alcohol transformation, with 100% reported yield after 1 hour.
Sodium borohydride is the prioritized reagent because it reduces ketones while generally preserving aryl halides, nitriles, and ethers under ordinary conditions.

entities.name: NaBH4 in methanol
observations: Methanol is the reported solvent; reaction time was approximately 1 hour and reported yield was 100% in ORD record ord-24609a5223c34cd78a78f558af13fca8.
